description: This file contains unit tests for the quic::QuicCryptoServerConfig class and related components, testing server configuration, certificate compression, source address tokens, and config management logic.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerConfigTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QuicCryptoServerConfig functionalities.

classes.name: SourceAddressTokenTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing source address token behaviors.

classes.name: CryptoServerConfigsTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing server configuration management.

classes.name: ValidateCallback
classes.description: A callback class for handling validation results in tests.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets server configs with specified IDs, primary times, and priorities for testing config management logic.

methods.name: NewSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Generates a new source address token for a given config ID and IP address, optionally with previous tokens or network parameters.

methods.name: ValidateSourceAddressTokens
methods.description: Validates source address tokens against IP and server config, optionally retrieving cached network parameters.

methods.name: CheckConfigs
methods.description: Checks the current server configs against expected primary status for testing.

methods.description: Selects a new primary server config based on current time for testing primary config switching.
